messages:
Maya: Quick idea — propose adding a `scope_bump` field to runtime config so we can temporarily widen a flag's scope for targeted diagnostics (short-lived, auditable).

Jason: sketch the schema? is this per-config, per-apply, per-route?

Maya: per-apply. minimal shape: `scope_bump: {type: "route_hash_shift", percent: 10, ttl_s: 3600, reason: "investigate-503-spike"}`. Default is null so backwards compatible.

Linda: flag: this can bypass quotas and gate logic if we aren't careful. need hard guardrails (audit + approval + quota checks).

Rahul: telemetry reqs: capture before/after sample rates, tokens delta, and route-level p95 difference. also record who applied and an apply_id.

Sam: Console asks: heatmap per-route showing bump traffic vs baseline, quick-revert action, banner for active bumps, plus history timeline.

ops-bot: FYI runbook draft: https://intra/runbooks/scope-bump. Will auto-create incident if p90-latency +5% for 5m.

console-bot: Preview mode: UI shows diffs panel and flagged audit entry for any `scope_bump` (mock in /ui/prototype).

Jason: impl note — reuse preview snapshot pipeline so we can dry-run the bump in shadow mode before apply. add `bump_reason` and `apply_id` to config change log.

Maya: Rollout plan: staging -> 1% of routes in prod (non-critical regions) for 24h smoke -> 5% for 48h -> wider. Start with read-only bumps (no quota increase) to validate telemetry.

Linda: Abort criteria: revert if p95 latency delta > 20ms AND error rate delta > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 5m windows, or cost delta > 20%.

Rahul: Telemetry knobs: `tokens_per_minute_by_bumped_route`, `p95_latency_delta_bumped_vs_baseline`, `cost_per_token_delta`, `config_apply_failures`. Also emit `bump_active` metric per region.

Sam: Dashboard mock: route heatmap (x: time, y: route shard), color by token delta, click-to-filter cohort, time-range slider, revert CTA, surface audit log entry.

Maya: Who owns the ops playbook and console changes? Linda + Sam pair?

Linda: I can own the playbook and abort criteria. Sam owns console mock + prototyping.

Rahul: Note: sampling consistency. If bump changes cache keys or KV behavior record cache-miss delta and ensure we don't pollute prefix caches.

Jason: API must be additive. default `scope_bump=null`. Gateway validate TTL and percent bounds (max 30% unless approved).

Sam: UX tip: show a compact diff in the console change flyout and mark bump as 'ephemeral' with TTL countdown.

Maya: I'll draft RFC + minimal server PR to emit metrics and staging handler. Ping when ready for review.

Jason: happy to review API + validation bits.

Linda: I'll add checklist to runbook and include abort playbook and approvers list.

ops-bot: Reminder: any `scope_bump` requires a 1-oncall + product owner ack during ramp.

Maya: noted. will add approver flow to RFC and include sample payload in RFC: `{ "scope_bump": { "type": "route_hash_shift", "percent": 10, "ttl_s": 3600, "reason": "investigate-503-spike" } }`

Rahul: sounds good. tagging @sam for console hooks.

Sam: will prototype heatmap + revert button in next sprint.

Maya: Next step: RFC + PRs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
